algorithm.representation: Recursive Expr enum with boxed children; immutable borrowed context slices, copying the context only when extending it for a let body.
algorithm.construction: Top-down construction from target type, exact positive node budget and context; no generation filtering, repair, retries, cached complete outputs, or proof-directed representation.
algorithm.root_type: int for even indices and bool for odd indices
algorithm.families: At one node choose literal or matching variable family equally if variables exist. At two nodes use unary; at three nodes choose equally among unary, binary and let; at four or more choose equally among unary, binary, let and if. Unary and binary constructors are determined by requested type.
algorithm.payloads: Byte literals choose among 0..255, booleans choose false/true, let binder type chooses int/bool equally, and variables choose a rank across every context index of the requested type.
algorithm.budgets: Binary and let choose the first child size from 1..N-2. If chooses condition size from 1..N-3, then true-branch size from 1..N-2-condition_size; final child gets the positive remainder. Children generate left to right with explicit returned RNG state.

rng.initialization: Sample i starts directly from unsigned 64-bit state seed+i.
rng.state_threading: Pure functions return (value, next_state); no mutable input or global RNG.
rng.bias: Modulo reduction has a tiny bias for non-power-of-two bounds. Feasible constructor families are approximately equiprobable. Literal versus variable is family-balanced, so individual leaves are not equally probable. Sequential positive budget splitting is not uniform over ternary compositions and favors larger early child budgets. Complete ASTs are not uniform.

included: fresh AST generation for every sample
recursive traversal of every node computing actual count and required wrapping-u64 digest
benchmark.entrypoints: Separate native sample and bench binaries use the same library generator; wrappers exec the optimized native binaries without invoking a compiler or interpreter.
benchmark.traversal: AST generation produces no cached count or digest. inspect recursively visits the actual freshly generated tree.

limitations.count: 1..2^64-1, subject to total-node and per-sample-seed overflow checks
limitations.cli: Exactly three nonempty ASCII unsigned decimal arguments; malformed/unsupported requests produce stderr and nonzero exit.
limitations.formal_claims: No formal proof or generator certification was attempted.
